title: Voice-assistant verification and operational review

releaseGates.DEF-V2-008: BLOCKED (requires enterprise live provider contract with 0-day retention and zero customer training)
releaseGates.DEF-V2-011: BLOCKED (requires physical ARM64 device testing with real microphone hardware and spoken TalkBack screen-reader ear listen-through)

summary: Completed comprehensive bounded voice-assistant verification and operational review using Phase 95's capture and transcript-review pipeline. Verified microphone permission handling with accessible text fallback; explicit record/stop/cancel lifecycle with local memory discard and zero network requests; native Bangla script Unicode preservation, English speech recognition, and code-switched (Banglish) fidelity; silence and low-confidence (<0.70) uncertainty detection with warning alerts; interrupted upload recovery and idempotent retries without duplicate records or double-charging; in-flight backgrounding and cancellation via AbortSignal; interactive editable transcript review preceding proposal generation; anti-hallucination task deadline ambiguity clarification without unreviewed writes; explicit Save/Confirm proposal execution with durable sync mutation receipts in app.mutation_receipts under AI_DEVICE_ID and canonical deep links; strict 0-day transient audio retention with server memory zeroing (Buffer.alloc(0)) and zero raw audio in database; decoupled hardware microphone permission vs external AI transmission consent (403 AI_CONSENT_REQUIRED); server kill switch (503 AI_KILL_SWITCH_ACTIVE); and multi-tenant workspace isolation. Evaluated mock vs live multimodal providers separately. Kept voice gated fail-closed under DEF-V2-008 and DEF-V2-011.
